potion.focus.name: Focus Syrup

upgrade.floating_pot.name: Floating Magic Pot
upgrade.floating_pot.desc: Makes the pot float mid-air in the greenhouse, adding a planting slot. 1st unlock adds the 4th slot, 2nd unlock adds the 5th.
upgrade.star_can.name: Star-Silver Watering Can
upgrade.star_can.desc: A magic watering can found at a second-hand market that splashes droplets everywhere. Tapping a planter also boosts adjacent planters by 50%.
upgrade.shears.name: Enchanted Garden Shears
upgrade.shears.desc: Shears engraved with Grimoire runes. Manual taps on plants have a 5% chance for "Critical Growth": instant harvest with yield ×3.
upgrade.fertilizer.name: Magic Fertilizer
upgrade.fertilizer.desc: Glow-in-the-dark fertilizer Lumia mixed herself. Increases all plant harvest yields by +10%/Lv (infinitely upgradeable).
upgrade.garden_gloves.name: Magical Gardening Gloves
upgrade.garden_gloves.desc: Put them on to channel magic into plants. Manual taps on planters grant extra automatic growth equal to "0.01 seconds × level" (scales with all growth speed bonuses; infinitely upgradeable).
upgrade.warm_circle.name: Warming Magic Circle
upgrade.warm_circle.desc: Warming runes drawn beneath the stove. Increases passive brewing speed for all cauldrons by +15%/Lv (infinitely upgradeable).
upgrade.servant_ladle.name: Invisible Servant Ladle
upgrade.servant_ladle.desc: A floating ladle that stirs wildly on its own. Multiplies all cauldron passive brewing speed by ×1.5 (max Lv 3).
upgrade.bellows.name: Dragon-Breath Bellows
upgrade.bellows.desc: Tap the same cauldron 10 times (within 1 second per tap) to trigger 5 seconds of "Rapid Boil": speed ×6. Followed by a 15-second cooldown.
upgrade.condenser.name: Double-Barrel Condenser
upgrade.condenser.desc: A dangerously jury-rigged invention. 15% chance per brewing cycle to produce ×2 items (only consumes ingredients for 1).
upgrade.rune_stirrer.name: Rune Stirring Rod
upgrade.rune_stirrer.desc: A stirring rod covered in acceleration runes. Manually stirring a cauldron grants extra passive brewing progress equal to "0.01 seconds × level" (scales with all brewing speed bonuses, works even without a salamander; infinitely upgradeable).
upgrade.abacus_squirrel.name: Abacus Squirrel
upgrade.abacus_squirrel.desc: A squirrel clerk holding a tiny abacus. Starting at Lv1, automatically checks out customers at the counter (one at a time, approx. 2.1s); higher levels shorten checkout time, and at max level (Lv9) orders are completed the moment customers reach the counter.
upgrade.fortune_owl.name: Lucky Owl
upgrade.fortune_owl.desc: A wooden owl carving perched on the cash register. Potion selling price +10%/Lv.
upgrade.signboard.name: Magic Signboard
upgrade.signboard.desc: A signboard that winks at passersby. Customer speed +15%/Lv (max Lv {max}: customer speed matches the fastest counter checkout speed).
upgrade.diffuser.name: Psychedelic Diffuser
upgrade.diffuser.desc: Mint and lavender aromas make customers lose track of time. Customer patience +30%.
upgrade.poster.name: Promotional Poster
upgrade.poster.desc: Potion ads plastered all over town. Increases the proportion of yield bought by customers by +3%/Lv (max 10 levels), selling more stock at full price.
upgrade.bell.name: Shop Bell
upgrade.bell.desc: Ring the counter bell to summon a customer instantly. Stores up to 3 charges, recovering 1 every 30 seconds.
upgrade.drunks.name: Generous Tippler
upgrade.drunks.desc: Tipsy adventurers don't even want their change. 5% chance per transaction for a Big Spender Tip: gold ×2.
upgrade.crate.name: Buyback Crate: {potion}
upgrade.crate.desc: Automatically buys back excess {potion} above the reserve limit. Lv1 buyback price is 30%, +10% per level (max 60%).
upgrade.crate_materials.name: Buyback Crate: Materials
upgrade.crate_materials.desc: Automatically buys back extra materials (each material can be toggled and configured with a reserve, defaulting to 60 seconds of full-speed cauldron brewing). Lv1 buyback price is 30%, +10% per level (max 60%).
upgrade.refine.name: Refine: {potion}
upgrade.refine.desc: Improve the recipe to make higher-grade potions: each level increases material requirements by 50% and selling price by 60% (permanent, and the cauldron waits if materials are low).
upgrade.guild_contract.name: Overworked Elves' Guild Contract
upgrade.guild_contract.desc: While offline, the elves simulate "5 taps per second" to help you grow plants and stir the cauldron.
target.raincloud.name: Mini Raincloud
target.fairy.name: Gluttonous Flower Fairy
target.salamander.name: Cauldron Salamander
target.salamander.desc: Lv1 grants passive brewing (50% base speed), then +25% per level
gift.snack.name: Handmade Treats
gift.snack.intro: Heart-shaped cookies baked with love and strawberry macarons, tied up nicely with a pink ribbon. Lumia said she'd save them until after closing, but ate them all the same day.
gift.snack.line: Yay! Treats! You're the best, Master~
gift.music_box.name: Fairy Music Box
gift.music_box.desc: Master's manual tap effect +50% (pots and cauldron).
gift.music_box.intro: Open the lid, and a little fairy figurine dances around in circles. Working to its melody makes your hands feel so light and brisk.
gift.music_box.line: A fairy is dancing inside! Spin around and round~
gift.slime_doll.name: Chibi Slime Plushie
gift.slime_doll.intro: A stuffed toy modeled after that sleepy slime in the greenhouse. It's super squishy and makes a squeak when you squeeze it. The ultimate naptime companion.
gift.slime_doll.line: So squishy! Can I hug it while I sleep?
gift.gramophone.name: Vintage Gramophone
gift.gramophone.desc: Upbeat music gets the elves motivated: plant growth and cauldron brewing speed +15%.
gift.gramophone.intro: An antique gramophone found at a flea market, with a horn shaped like a blooming flower. Playing lively tunes even gets the elves tapping along.
gift.gramophone.line: Having music playing makes work extra fun♪
gift.tea_set.name: Fancy Magic Tea Set
gift.tea_set.desc: Refreshing and invigorating: Lumia's stamina consumption while working -50%.
gift.tea_set.intro: Fine porcelain tea set decorated with purple patterns. The magic tea brewed inside gives off heart-shaped steam. One sip makes you full of energy.
gift.tea_set.line: Such lovely tea… Would you like a cup too, Master?
gift.bouquet.name: Magic Bouquet
gift.bouquet.desc: The floral scent puts customers in a great mood: purchase quantity per customer +20%.
gift.bouquet.intro: A softly glowing pastel bouquet with tiny light specks floating between the petals. Placing it in the shop makes the whole room smell wonderful.
gift.bouquet.line: S-Such pretty flowers… I'll display them nicely in the shop!
gift.hairpin.name: Starlight Hairpin
gift.hairpin.desc: Lumia feels extra confident wearing it: assigns a ×1.5 bonus to work areas.
gift.hairpin.intro: A golden hairpin shaped like a crescent moon and stars, inlaid with a tiny amethyst. Lumia looked in the mirror for ages after putting it on.
gift.hairpin.line: Is this… for me? I-I'll wear it all the time!
gift.star_lamp.name: Wish Star Lamp
gift.star_lamp.intro: A star-shaped small desk lamp tied with several wish ribbons. They say if you whisper your wish to it, the stars will help make it come true.
gift.star_lamp.line: If you tell your wishes to the stars, they'll come true!
gift.dream_catcher.name: Moonlight Dream Catcher
gift.dream_catcher.intro: A crescent-framed dream catcher draped with feathers and star beads. Hang it by the bed and all bad dreams will get caught.
gift.dream_catcher.line: With this, I'm sure to have sweet dreams tonight… Yawn~
gift.crystal_ball.name: Astrology Crystal Ball
gift.crystal_ball.intro: An astrology crystal ball resting on a brass base, with pink-purple star mist swirling inside. Lumia says she saw a wonderful future in it.
gift.crystal_ball.line: I saw it… Master and me, together in this shop forever and ever!
redeem.decor_slot_3.name: Lounge Expansion: Cushion Side
redeem.decor_slot_3.desc: Adds a display slot on the floor next to the cushion so you can place one more gift.
redeem.decor_slot_4.name: Lounge Expansion: Stair Side
redeem.decor_slot_4.desc: Adds a display slot by the stairs so you can place one more gift.
redeem.outfit_maid.name: Elegant Maid Dress
redeem.outfit_maid.desc: Bows when idle. Assigned to the Counter: potion price +50%; customers buy 20% fewer per visit, but pay the full original price.
redeem.outfit_pajama.name: Starry Fluffy Pajamas
redeem.outfit_pajama.desc: rubs eyes and yawns during interactions. While wearing when offline, offline efficiency +20% (base 50%, max 90%).
redeem.outfit_gardener.name: Garden Fairy Apron
redeem.outfit_gardener.desc: Wears a flower crown and hums to plants. Assigned to the Greenhouse: plant growth speed +100%.
redeem.outfit_robe.name: Master Alchemist Robe
redeem.outfit_robe.desc: Taps feel more confident. Assigned to the Cauldron area: brewing speed +100%.
redeem.cheer.name: Maiden's Cheer
redeem.cheer.desc: Permanently boosts potion prices +20% (purchasable infinitely, price increases each time).
redeem.attunement.name: Mana Attunement
redeem.attunement.desc: Double condenser double drop chance +10% (up to 5 times, price increases each time).
redeem.green_thumb.name: Miracle Green Thumb
redeem.green_thumb.desc: Doubles the harvest yield of floating planters (slots 4 and 5 bought with gold).
redeem.telepathy.name: Telepathy
redeem.telepathy.desc: Extends offline earnings calculation cap from 12 hours to 72 hours, and slows down offline efficiency decay (takes 72 hours to halve).
redeem.opening.name: Prologue: Apprentice Shopkeeper
redeem.opening.desc: Lumia returns to the workshop after graduating from the academy and meets Master, who was left behind inside the grimoire. The opening story can be replayed at any time.
redeem.celebration.name: First Celebration Party
redeem.celebration.desc: Triggers story events and unlocks CG. Permanent effect: potion price ×3.
redeem.vow.name: Vow Under the Starry Sky
redeem.vow.desc: Final storyline. Unlocks after collecting all 3 letters from afar and reaching shop Renown Lv {renown}. Unlocks "Fever Time": once per day, all production speed ×10 for 60 seconds.

assign.patrol.desc: Lumia rotates between the greenhouse, cauldron area, and counter. Effects match her current zone, and she still consumes Stamina.

assign.rest.name: Lounge
assign.rest.desc: Sleeps on the cushion to recover Stamina (recovers faster when assigned by Master) and slowly generates Happiness. When Stamina is full, she relaxes in the lounge.
